title: Immutable Git tracked snapshot as Pattern C provenance source
statement: When a Consumer repository is declared canonical in Git, Pattern C may use an immutable repository commit/tree reference plus explicit validation coverage instead of requiring a duplicate raw ZIP archive; validation coverage must remain explicit and raw repository contents are not copied into Canonical Knowledge.
rationale: This preserves stronger VCS identity, avoids redundant archive handling, and does not weaken privacy or canonical authority boundaries.
